details: As of June 21, 2026, Bitcoin (BTC) increased by 1.29% to $64,168.33, while Ethereum (ETH) rose by 1.84% to $1,735.16, reflecting demand in the smart contract sector. Solana (SOL) surged 5.06% to $73.12, but other smaller coins showed mixed performance, highlighting market volatility. Bitcoin continues to hold above the $63,000-$64,000 range despite recent ETF outflows and macroeconomic pressures.
title: Bitcoin and Ethereum Show Stability, Major Altcoins Fluctuate

details: Reports indicate that Japan's corporate pension fund intends to allocate 1% of its assets to cryptocurrencies. This move signals a growing institutional interest in digital assets within traditional finance.
title: Japan Pension Fund Plans 1% Crypto Allocation

details: Ethereum Layer 2 solution Taiko has temporarily halted block production following an exploit, advising users to withdraw their funds. This incident highlights ongoing security challenges within the decentralized finance ecosystem.
title: Taiko Layer 2 Halts Due to Exploit, Users Urged to Withdraw Funds

details: South Korea's Toss Bank is set to test blockchain-based financial infrastructure on the Solana network. This initiative aims to leverage Solana's speed for global payments and other financial services, potentially expanding its adoption.
title: Toss Bank Tests Solana for Blockchain Financial Infrastructure

details: Cryptocurrency exchange Bitget has introduced a new feature enabling users to directly purchase US stocks using cryptocurrencies. This integration bridges traditional financial markets with the crypto space, offering more utility to digital assets.
title: Bitget Allows Direct US Stock Purchases with Crypto

details: The cryptocurrency market remains under the influence of macroeconomic factors, including Federal Reserve interest rate decisions, persistent inflation (PCE data due this week), and geopolitical tensions. The market is in a consolidation phase, with Bitcoin's ability to maintain its price range crucial for broader sentiment.
title: Fed Decisions, Inflation, and Geopolitics Shape Crypto Outlook

details: The NFT-born franchise Pudgy Penguins is expanding its retail footprint by launching trading cards in Target stores across the US. This strategic move aims to build the brand's intellectual property and reach a mainstream audience amidst a shifting NFT market.
title: Pudgy Penguins Launch Trading Cards at Target
